tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Read a public web page or document and return clean, LLM-ready markdown. Pricing: $0.001 (1 sat) per read, or $0.003 (3 sats) when scan is true. The free tier applies first, shared with the HTTP API and all MCP tools.

tools.name: scan_text
tools.description: Scan text for prompt-injection risk and return a risk level, score, and signals. Pricing: $0.002 (2 sats) per scan. The free tier applies first, shared with the HTTP API and all MCP tools.
